description: Give any thread a persona you define once: its job, voice, expertise and hard limits, the same in every thread that runs it. An agent interviews you in four to seven questions and puts the draft on a review card, and nothing is saved, edited or deleted until you approve. Pick a soul from the composer's + menu for an open thread or the next one, and a banner shows it with a pixel-art portrait that animates with what the agent is doing. After a context compaction the persona goes back in, and a parent thread can start a child already in character. Compare a soul with no soul on the same prompt before you rely on it. Souls stay in the plugin's own SQLite store with no account or external service, and a comparison spends model runs only when you start it.
